sloka: यदि रामो दशग्रीवमिह हत्वा सबान्धवम् ।मामितो गृह्य गच्छेत तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत् ।। ५.३७.६२।।।।
transliteration: yadi rāmo daśagrīvamiha hatvā sabāndhavam ।māmito gṛhya gaccheta tattasya sadṛśaṁ bhavet ।। 5.37.62।।।।

translations.english: "I had no control over myself. I was helpless and my husband was not present when I had to bear the touch of Ravana's limbs. What can I do?
